shortBio.en: Smashing Pumpkins leader; wall-of-guitar production and alt-radio hooks.
shortBio.zh: Smashing Pumpkins 领袖；吉他墙制作与 alternative 电台钩子。

body.en:
Born 1967. Writes Siamese Dream / Mellon Collie. Multi-tracks guitars with Butch Vig/Flood eras. Lineup churn; Corgan seat is constant.

Production density is the 90s alt citation beside quieter Pixies dynamics.
body.zh:
1967 年生。写 Siamese Dream / Mellon Collie。与 Butch Vig/Flood 时期多轨吉他。阵容动荡；Corgan 席位是常量。

制作密度是 90 年代 alt 引用，对照更安静的 Pixies 动态。
